workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:

Mon: 11:00-11:30, 11:30-12:00
Tue: 09:00-09:30, 09:30-10:00
Wed: 13:00-13:30, 13:30-14:00

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text: Great, thanks Brad! I've found a common slot. I've booked the meeting for Thursday at 14:30. It's in the system, so you can go ahead and send the confirmation email.

emails.body: Hi all, this is a confirmation that the partners' meeting has been scheduled for Thursday at 14:30.
